_doc: How attacks and barriers look when they meet walls and cover (read by src/render/fx/wall_fx.gd).
Visual only, driven by engine events and state: the attack_rolled event (cover, cover_cells,
phase/via when the engine sends them), the weapon's tags and mod, terrain_damaged/destroyed,
zone_changed/removed, damage to barrier deployables. A hole stays in a wall only when the state
says the wall was damaged (terrain_damaged); the per-cell damage stages are drawn by the terrain
paths: how the shot travels. Checked in this order: event flags, the weapon's mod, the weapon id,
the weapon's tags, then what the attacker's effects say (ignores cover).
phase       Phase-Ready: the shot sinks into the wall with a ripple and comes out behind it.
throughbolt Throughbolt Rounds: one straight bolt that punches through everything on its line.
arc         Arcing: lobbed high over whatever is in the way.
seek        Seeking: curves around obstacles to reach the target.
see_through ignores cover: a targeting line shows through the cover, the shot doesn't stop at it.
teleport    the attacker or blade folds space (the moved event, mode teleport, shows the jump).
cover_hits: what a miss into cover looks like (the shot strikes the cover cell from cover_cells).
barriers: zone kinds and deployable names that shimmer where shots cross, flicker as they weaken
(max_hp when the zone has HP) and shatter when destroyed.
items: every book item that interacts with walls or cover, with what it shows (or why nothing).

items.wm_phase_ready_mod: phase (Napoleon: fires through walls, no line of sight or cover needed)
items.wm_throughbolt_rounds: throughbolt (Napoleon: a line through cover and terrain)
items.tg_arcing: arc (Howitzer, Mortar, Burst Launcher, Sharanga/Pinaka/Shatterhead missiles, Oracle LMG-I and anything else tagged)
items.tg_seeking: seek (Gandiva Missiles, Swarm/Hive Nanites, Autopod, Smartgun and anything else tagged)
items.t_gunslinger: see_through when the attack ignores cover
items.mf_pegasus: see_through (By the Way, I Know Everything / Mimic Gun ignore cover)
items.ms_markerlight: see_through (no soft cover while Locked On)
items.t_siege_specialist: terrain_damaged / terrain_destroyed (holes and collapse drawn from state)
